intro: Journey to Sentinel Hill directs Alliance adventurers into the troubled farmlands of Westfall to report to the outpost at Sentinel Hill. Frustrated by months of unanswered pleas for royal reinforcements from Stormwind, local commanders are ready to put any willing traveler straight to work.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: If you'd like to get started doing some good in our world, I'd recommend reporting to a man named Gryan Stoutmantle in Westfall to the south, at the settlement known as Sentinel Hill. His people are in need of aid.

After journeying here from another plane of existence, the problems our lands face may seem small. I assure you, the aid you provide to those impacted by such problems means everything to them, and you will grow stronger for your labors.

clips.title: Completion
paras: I've been begging Stormwind for aid for months and he sends me a skinny elf? Well, beggars can't be choosers I suppose.
Welcome to Westfall, adventurer. Let's see if we can't put you to work.
